[SWS_LinTrcv_00166] ⌈The function LinTrcv_CheckWakeup shall evaluate the
wakeup on the addressed LIN network.
When a wake-up event on the addressed
LIN network is detected (e.g. dominant bus state or negative edge at wakeup pin), the
function LinTrcv_CheckWakeup shall notify the ECU State Manager module immedi-
ately via the EcuM_SetWakeupEvent and LinIf v
